name: Body Language
overview: Scripture reveals that the human body, created in God's image, is both a sacred vessel and an expression of spiritual truth. Jesus' own posture of lifting His eyes to heaven exemplifies how body language can reflect inner communion with the Father. Believers are called to present their bodies as living sacrifices, holy and pleasing to God, demonstrating that our physical being is integral to worship and service. Furthermore, the body is described as the fullness of Christ, emphasizing its vital role in His work and presence among His people.
